//! Kitchen-sink fixture: covers queries, mutations, jobs, workflows, models,
//! enums, custom args, Option/Vec, and tables-with-dependencies declarations.

use forge::prelude::*;
use uuid::Uuid;

#[forge_enum]
pub enum TodoStatus {
    Open,
    InProgress,
    Done,
}

#[forge::model]
pub struct Todo {
    pub id: Uuid,
    pub user_id: Uuid,
    pub title: String,
    pub status: TodoStatus,
    pub due_at: Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>>,
    pub created_at: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct CreateTodoInput {
    pub title: String,
    pub status: TodoStatus,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct CleanupRequest {
    pub older_than_days: i32,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct CleanupOutput {
    pub deleted_count: i64,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ReportInput {
    pub user_id: Uuid,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ReportOutput {
    pub url: String,
}

#[forge::query(tables("todos"))]
pub async fn list_my_todos(ctx: &QueryContext) -> Result<Vec<Todo>> {
    Ok(vec![])
}

#[forge::query(auth = "none", tables("todos"))]
pub async fn count_by_status(ctx: &QueryContext, status: TodoStatus) -> Result<i64> {
    Ok(0)
}

#[forge::mutation]
pub async fn create_todo(ctx: &MutationContext, input: CreateTodoInput) -> Result<Todo> {
    unimplemented!()
}

#[forge::mutation]
pub async fn delete_todo(ctx: &MutationContext, id: Uuid) -> Result<bool> {
    Ok(true)
}

#[forge::job(timeout = "10m", retry(max_attempts = 2))]
pub async fn cleanup_old_todos(ctx: &JobContext, request: CleanupRequest) -> Result<CleanupOutput> {
    Ok(CleanupOutput { deleted_count: 0 })
}

#[forge::workflow(name = "build_report", version = "2026-05", timeout = "30m")]
pub async fn build_report(ctx: &WorkflowContext, input: ReportInput) -> Result<ReportOutput> {
    Ok(ReportOutput { url: "/r".into() })
}

#[forge::cron(schedule = "0 * * * *")]
pub async fn hourly_cleanup(ctx: &CronContext) -> Result<()> {
    Ok(())
}
